job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is Clark County, Washington’s RFP for a deferred compensation 457 plan administrator, not LACERS’s actuarial RFP. Its five-year minimum applies to a proposing firm, not a lead actuary; it provides no support for the requested experience requirement.
quotes: REQUEST for PROPOSAL # 955 PROFESSIONAL, TECHNICAL AND EXPERT SERVICES Clark County Washington
Request for Proposal for: DEFERRED COMPENSATION 457 PLAN ADMINISTRATOR
The Proposing Firm must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience administering governmental Section 457 deferred compensation plans
